areas.t: Saturday, light winds will limit dispersion as a surface ridge of high pressure shifts southward across Louisiana. Furthermore, smoke from scattered agricultural fires will contribute to particle levels in some locations. Additionally, an evening temperature inversion will inhibit low-level mixing,
